ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

John 12:44–50 is translated from Tolstoy's Russian, with «отец» (otets, 'father') and the pronouns for God lowercase as in the source; Tolstoy's italic «я» (ya, 'I') is kept as an italic '*I*'. «Благо» (blago) is 'the good' («источник истинного блага», istochnik istinnogo blaga, 'the source of the true good'; «путь блага», put' blaga, 'the path of the good'), where the website draft had 'goodness'.

Source observation: [5] The Gospel reference is printed «Ин. гл. 12, cm. 44—50» with Latin «cm.» in place of Cyrillic «ст.» (st., 'verse'); the reference itself is correct and is rendered John 12:44–50.
